COLLEGE PROJECT / 2026

Act II: Fun Land

Movie-night energy, right on the shelf.

Packaging · Illustration
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

This college project reimagines the Sour Cream & Cheese popcorn pack as a playful world. The goal was to bring the enjoyment of snacking into the packaging itself.

The design

“Fun Land” combines appetising product photography with illustrations inspired by popcorn, flowing sour cream and melting cheese. A lively composition gives the flavour a story of its own.

Student packaging redesign. Not commissioned by or affiliated with Act II.
